channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Kaman | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Kaman from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ed Davis on Chris Kaman
item.description:
“There are some veterans like Chris Kaman, for example, who can tell us stories and talk about things that he has been through. But we do have a lot of young guys and all of us are hungry. We all still have stuff to prove and we’re all in that 23-to-27 age range. Hopefully we can keep this thing together for a long time.”

Ed Davis on Chris Kaman, Jan 15, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Joel Freeland on Chris Kaman
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Joel Freeland on #blazers’ addition of Chris Kaman:

“It’s a business. What can we do? He’s a great player. He’s going to help us a lot. It means me and Meyers (Leonard) have to pick it up more and prove our worth so we can play on this team.”

Joel Freeland on Chris Kaman, Jul 8, 2014. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Chris Kaman
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Kobe on the Cleveland game:

“Kaman goes to sleep on the bench ... It's like when big brother is not around stuff starts going crazy”

Kobe Bryant on Chris Kaman, Feb 9, 2014. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chris Kaman
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Rick Carlisle on Kaman, who discussed his coaching style:

“It didn’t work out well here … I take my share of the responsibility.”

Rick Carlisle on Chris Kaman, Nov 5, 2013. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Chris Kaman
item.description:
Gasol:

“We have a new big man like Kaman and I think it's good for us, but we need a lot more.”

Pau Gasol on Chris Kaman, Jul 12, 2013. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Chris Kaman
item.description:
They fell behind Charlotte 17-4 and trailed Minnesota after one period, 25-17.

“I think it will get us off to a better start, and I think it will get (Kaman) into the rhythm of the game more,”

Mark Cuban on Chris Kaman, Nov 14, 2012. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Chris Kaman
item.description:
“We’ve never had a low-post presence like Chris Kaman since I’ve been here, certainly; a guy that we can throw the ball into and you don’t have to throw the ball to Dirk every other possession,”

Donnie Nelson on Chris Kaman, Aug 27, 2012. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Chris Kaman, Dahntay Jones
item.description:
Mavericks coach Rick Carlisle said.

“Collison is well thought of as a player and a person, and Kaman has been one of the better low-post players in the league for the last eight years. We feel Dahntay Jones is a premier defender that brings toughness and he shot the 3 well the last two years.”

Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Chris Kaman, Dahntay Jones, Jul 13, 2012. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Sergio Scariolo on Chris Kaman
item.description:
Spanish coach Sergio Scariolo,betraying his lack of Clippers knowledge, said as he turned to his German counterpart, Dirk Bauermann, in the post-game news conference.

“Marc tried to stop Kaman from going to his left because he knows he likes that move, and he is so effective because he notices those kinds of small details. It’s not just his size and his scoring ability,”

Sergio Scariolo on Chris Kaman, Sep 7, 2011. Source: SheridanHoops.
